@trust-dsl:1 @procedure:hall-municipality-clarification @version:0.1.0 @intent-chaining
Feature: Clarify municipality configuration in Hall before product review
  the user requests a main-menu municipality screen, distinct read and write authority,
  existing roles examined before new ones, server authorization reflected by Siren,
  and existing Hall visual primitives. HALL-FR-COM-010 records only this accepted need.
  Exact fields and profile allocations remain undecided. Agent proposals are not decisions.
  Clarification is progressive and specific to Hall; no implementation is authorized.
  Background: Plan context
    Given Procedure scope
      | check | authorized | forbidden |
      | all | Read current Hall WIP and requirements; record clarification reports and product questions; declare bounded inline clarification missions; project sourced review material to Maket. | Implement application code; change data models or invariants; mutate business data; migrate; commit; push; deploy; infer product approval; promote agent deductions to accepted requirements. |
    And one reference "requirement"
    And missions "clarifications" declared by agent
    And many string "clarification reports"
  @scenario:clarify
  Scenario: Gather the declared perspectives on the same requirement
    Then Invocation "clarify municipality configuration" runs each declared Procedure in "clarifications"
      and materializes "clarification reports" from Result "clarification report"
      and must establish "the declared clarification reports are recorded, without approving their proposals"

@trust-dsl:1 @procedure:hall-municipality-database-clarification @version:0.1.0 @intent-chaining
Feature: Clarify the database perspective of HALL-FR-COM-010
  Accepted need: main-menu municipality configuration screen; appropriate read access;
  distinct write access, server-controlled and reflected by Siren; reuse existing Hall UI.
  Examine existing roles before proposing new permissions. Exact fields and profile
  allocations remain the user's decisions. Proposals do not change the accepted requirement.
  Clarify existing municipality data, authorities, invariants, operations and requirement interactions. Read code and documentation only; do not inspect private production records. Identify missing criteria, tensions and readiness with sources.
  Produce a sourced report identifying existing coverage, missing requirement details,
  tensions, proposed acceptance clarifications, and whether this perspective is sufficiently
  clarified with reasons. Stop before implementation. The Check records this report;
  VALIDATED means the structured report is available, not that the feature is ready or approved.
  Background: Plan context
    Given Procedure scope
      | check | authorized | forbidden |
      | all | Read current Hall WIP, catalogue and upstream clarification reports; write only docs/clarification-commune/database.json; record the report through the supplied Runner Check. | Modify code, catalogue, backlog, model, invariants, or business data; run migrations; approve proposals; implement; commit; push; deploy; launch further agents. |
    And one string "requirement"
    And one string "clarification report" returned
  @scenario:report
  Scenario: Record the sourced requirement clarification
    Then Check "record database clarification" runs Operation "hall.municipality-database-report@0.1.0"
      on "requirement" as Input "requirement"
      and materializes "clarification report" from field "report"
      and must establish "the authored report records missing details, tensions and a reasoned readiness assessment with source references; no product approval is inferred"
      """js
      fact.requirement === "HALL-FR-COM-010" && fact.perspective === "database" && fact.report !== "" && fact.missing !== "" && fact.tensions !== "" && fact.sourceRefs.length > 0 && fact.catalogue.includes("HALL-FR-COM-010") || fail("The report must identify the requirement, perspective, gaps, tensions and sources")
      """
operationSources:
@trust-dsl:1 @operation:hall.municipality-database-report @version:0.1.0
Feature: Observe the authored database clarification report and current requirement catalogue
  This records an agent report, not independent proof of its correctness or product approval.
  Background: Operation interface
    Given Environment
      | name | type |
      | workspaceRoot | directory |
    And Input
      | input | type | cardinality |
      | requirement | string | one |
    And Produced fields
      | field | type | cardinality | domain |
      | requirement | string | one | any |
      | perspective | string | one | any |
      | report | string | one | any |
      | missing | string | one | any |
      | tensions | string | one | any |
      | readiness | string | one | enum "clarified", "needs-decision" |
      | sourceRefs | string | many | any |
      | catalogue | string | one | any |
  Scenario: Run
    When File "report" reads "docs/clarification-commune/database.json" as JSON from Environment "workspaceRoot"
    And File "catalogue" reads "requirements/catalog.json" as Text from Environment "workspaceRoot"
    Then Produce with JSONata
      """
      {"requirement": steps.report.content.requirement, "perspective": steps.report.content.perspective, "report": steps.report.content.report, "missing": steps.report.content.missing, "tensions": steps.report.content.tensions, "readiness": steps.report.content.readiness, "sourceRefs": steps.report.content.sourceRefs, "catalogue": steps.catalogue.content}
      """
